en: Black-and-white postcard view of a small riverside village with several houses at the foot of a wooded hillside. In the foreground is the riverbank with a path or road running alongside the water. A small landing or dock is visible at the river's edge. Behind the road stand trees and a cluster of buildings, including what appears to be an inn or guesthouse. Terraced slopes and dense forest rise up the hill behind the village. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.
